name: Tahams
description: I started at Tahams as an intern. After three months, I joined the team as a Creative Visual Designer. I design T-shirts and posters for Tahams and its sister businesses.

timeline.title: Design internship
timeline.text: Started as an intern before joining the team officially.

timeline.title: Creative Visual Designer
timeline.text: Designing T-shirts and posters for Tahams and its sister businesses.

name: HoneyComb Inc.
description: HoneyComb Inc. is the parent company of Tahams. My work is through Tahams, where I design T-shirts and posters for the company and its sister businesses.

timeline.title: Work through Tahams
timeline.text: HoneyComb is Tahams’ parent company. My design work is through Tahams and its sister businesses.

name: JCI Bangladesh
description: I worked on the logo and visual identity for Mukto Pani, an award-winning community project by JCI Dhaka Imperial, a local chapter of JCI Bangladesh. The project focuses on clean water and sanitation and supports SDG 6.

timeline.title: Mukto Pani project
timeline.text: Worked on the logo and visual identity for the JCI Dhaka Imperial community project.

name: Huckleberry Natural BD
description: I worked as a General Sales Manager at Huckleberry Natural BD, a business that sells natural care products.

timeline.title: General Sales Manager
timeline.text: Worked with the natural care product business.

name: Paper House — Web Design Agency
description: Paper House Web Design Agency is the parent business of Paper House Design Agency, where I work part-time. I designed both logos. I am not directly employed by the web design agency.

name: Paper House — Design Agency
description: I currently work part-time as a designer at Paper House. I designed the logos for both the design agency and its parent web design agency. My current work focuses on redesigning logos for clients.

timeline.title: Part-time Designer
timeline.text: Designed both Paper House logos. Currently redesigning logos for clients.

name: East West University Debating Club
description: I joined the East West University Debating Club as a designer. I create event posters, announcements and campaign graphics for the club.

timeline.title: Club design work
timeline.text: Designing posters and graphics for club events and announcements.

name: Motijheel Model Science Club
description: I started as a general member of Motijheel Model Science Club and became a senior volunteer in 2019. I served as president from 2021 to 2022. I also contributed designs and worked on the club logo redesign.

timeline.title: President
timeline.text: Led the club and its activities.

name: Motijheel Model Debating Society
description: I joined Motijheel Model Debating Society as a member and became Organizing Secretary in 2021. I helped organize club activities and contributed design work.

timeline.title: Organizing Secretary
timeline.text: Promoted to help organize club activities.

name: HPC Science Club
description: I joined HPC Science Club in 2023 and served as president from 2023 to 2024. I then supported the club as an advisor from 2024 to 2025.

timeline.title: Joined HPC Science Club
timeline.text: Began taking part in club activities.

timeline.title: President
timeline.text: Led the club and its activities.

name: East West University Photography Club
description: I joined the East West University Photography Club as a designer. I create posters and graphics for club celebrations, announcements and member achievements.

timeline.title: Club design work
timeline.text: Creating posters and visual content for the photography club.
